meta.scope: Blender 5.2.0; all operating systems and compute types
meta.coreCountSource: CPU core counts are product specifications from the exact ChipIndex dashboard spec rows, based on AMD official product data and Intel ARK exports. They are not measured or reported by Blender Open Data.
meta.deviceSegmentSource: CPU device segments come from the exact official model in retained AMD Form Factor and Intel ARK Vertical Segment exports. AMD CPUs listed for both laptops and desktops appear in both filters. Blender medians pool systems and do not identify the tested chassis, power limit, or cooling.
